The YEASTRACT+ regulation file for \org{Saccharomyces cerevisiae} holds
\ytNRows{} rows of evidence that a transcription factor regulates a target
gene, credited to \ytNPapers{} papers. Table~\ref{tab:all} lists every paper,
most rows first, with its DOI, PubMed and PubMed Central links.
\ytNSpellPapers{} of the papers are also studies in the SPELL expression
archive, and one more reanalyzes a SPELL study. Table~\ref{tab:leverage} ranks
the papers outside SPELL: \ytNPapersToFifty{} of them carry half of the rows
credited outside the archive and \ytNLeveragePapers{} carry \ytLeveragePct{}
percent.
